_readme: Generic ApplicationConfiguration row for the detect / queue / send pattern (chapter 04, section 4). Assign it to the module that owns the notifications. The webhook URLs are NOT here: they live only in the Connections (teamsAlertsWebhook, teamsDmWebhook). Normalise on read so a bad hand edit falls back to the defaults.
name: Teams Notification Settings
description: Switches and parameters for Teams channel alerts and direct messages.

live.description: false: nothing is queued or posted

channelEvents.description: events that post to the alerts channel

dmAllowedDomains.description: DMs only to these e-mail domains

pilotRedirectUpn.description: when set, every card goes to this person as a [TEST for ...] DM
